claim_summaries.claim: The target infinitesimal two-qubit gate satisfies Chen-Liu linear triangle inequalities throughout alpha >= |gamma|, while exact rational fixtures and an asymptotic calculation show Cai-Liu-Lu squared-triangle hypotheses fail for nonzero gamma at sufficiently small step size.

Chen-Liu EPR counting overlaps the gamma=-alpha zero-field endpoint; Bravyi-Gosset covers gamma=0,b_v=0 up to scalar shift; HMS Theorem 47 structurally contains the edge cone but does not approximate this target partition function; HMS Theorem 50 is restricted to the easy-axis equal-transverse XXZ/uniform-field regime.
